name: Sales Report - per Salesman
query:
SELECT
    st.sales_person AS 'Sales Person:Link/Sales Person:200',
    dn.currency AS 'Ccy',
    SUM(dn.total) AS "Amount:Currency/ccy:",
    SUM(dn.total_taxes_and_charges) AS "Tax:Currency/ccy:",
    SUM(dn.discount_amount) AS 'Disc:Currency/ccy:',
    SUM(dn.grand_total) AS "Total:Currency/ccy:"
FROM
    `tabDelivery Note` AS dn
INNER JOIN
    /* SUBQUERY: Hanya ambil kombinasi Parent + Sales Person yang unik */
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT parent, sales_person
        FROM `tabSales Team`
        WHERE parenttype = 'Delivery Note' /* Pastikan hanya mengambil tipe Delivery Note */
    ) AS st ON st.parent = dn.name
WHERE
    dn.docstatus = 1
    AND dn.is_return = 0
    AND dn.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY
    st.sales_person, dn.currency
ORDER BY
    SUM(dn.grand_total) DESC;
